title: Eu5(μ4-OH)(μ3-OH)4(μ-DBM)4(DBM)6 (DBM = dibenzoylmethide): a novel Eu5 square-pyramid polynuclear complex with a rare μ4-OH bridging mode

synthesis.procedure: Europium oxide chloride (EuOCl) or EuCl3 (1 mmol) was reacted with HDBM (3 mmol) in the presence of N-methylmorpholine (2 ml) in 150 ml of absolute alcohol. The resulting yellow solution was filtered and evaporated at room temperature for a few weeks to give pale-yellow columnar crystals of 1.

reagents.name: europium oxide chloride (EuOCl) or europium(III) chloride

synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: yellow solution filtered and evaporated at room temperature for a few weeks; pale-yellow columnar crystals suitable for X-ray analysis

properties.summary: Solid-state fluorescence of cluster 1 shows strong red Eu3+ luminescence assigned to 5D0 → 7F0–4 transitions. A single 5D0 → 7F0 peak near 581 nm indicates one Eu3+ site; the electric-dipole 5D0 → 7F2 band is more intense than magnetic-dipole 5D0 → 7F1. Reported lifetime is 60 ns. No broad ~450 nm emission of Eu2+ was observed.

measurements.name: 5D0 → 7F0 emission wavelength
measurements.conditions: powder/solid state, room temperature; LS-50B fluorimeter (Fig. 2)

measurements.name: emission lifetime
measurements.conditions: solid-state fluorescence of 1 at room temperature
